scene_1.text_1: The Power Belt generates stress when creatures move across it.
scene_1.text_2: The faster creatures move above it, the higher the speed and stress it produces.
scene_1.text_3: Stress from multiple entities stacks, but speed does not.
scene_1.text_4: Use a Fixed Fishing Rod to put animals to work.
